summary.en: Simpler Settings (seven pages; search changes settings in a sentence; where each app starts is learned); autocomplete (beta) after a pause; suggestions as you type from plugins and your own programs (GitHub issues: #12 → #1234); Code, an input for writing code; the magic key; and fixes.
summary.zh: 更简单的设置（七页；搜索框里一句话改设置；每个 App 从哪种输入开始靠学）；停顿后的续写（Beta）；插件和你自己的程序提供的打字建议（GitHub issue：#12 → #1234）；写代码用的代码输入；魔法键；以及若干修复。
